comment: M05 No Forwarding Address golden-slice art review. FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/m05_no_forwarding_address.json. Eye-height spectator views of every beat on the authored route, from the roof stair among the water tanks to the Common Carrier on the pad, with the roof guards placed from the start. Look at each still against docs/design/earth.md (M05 Low Water roofs), the Level 4 stills and the Recall Notice bar; this is art review, not combat or fresh-player evidence.

states.name: roof_arrival
states.note: Arrival: the roof stair from Level 4 comes out among the water tanks; the plank bridge and the far roof ahead, the Notaries over the crossing.

states.name: roof_tanks
states.note: The water tanks on the roof loop: the skyline that returns in the wipe.

states.name: roof_over_market
states.note: Over the roof edge to the market below: awning, stalls and the drop back down.

states.name: roof_bridge
states.note: The plank bridge across the street gap toward the Clerks' roof.

states.name: street_gap
states.note: Down from the bridge into the street the sweep holds.

states.name: roof_skyline_workshop
states.note: From the roof edge over the open tram workshop to the trench and the freight platform beyond.

states.name: east_roof_crane
states.note: The far roof and Level 4's gantry crane, now underfoot, over the crane walk.

states.name: crane_walk_descent
states.note: Down the crane walk's treads into the workshop.

states.name: workshop_floor
states.note: The workshop floor from the east door: paint bay, chassis, service bay, loading pen.

states.name: paint_bay
states.note: The paint-bay bench where the Grenades lie, with room to throw.

states.name: grenade_lesson
states.note: From the bench over the stripped tram chassis where the Sweeper squad crouches.

states.name: loading_pen
states.note: The Union loading pen on the workshop floor, Splice and the captive agents inside.

states.name: service_bay
states.note: The tram service bay and its inspection pit, the secret six.

states.name: market_below
states.note: The market strip below the roofs, its awning and the supply shortcut.

states.name: trench_from_workshop
states.note: The tram trench from the workshop mouth: Splice's patched tram, crossings and recesses, floodlights at the end.

states.name: patched_tram
states.note: Splice's patched tram at its dock, ready to roll.

states.name: trench_bridge
states.note: From the foot crossing over the trench toward the platform ramp.

states.name: trench_recess
states.note: A trench wall with its maintenance recess and cover.

states.name: heavy_ramp
states.note: The end ramp where the Heavy Sweeper comes alone.

states.name: freight_gate
states.note: The freight platform gate, the level's one door, and its floodlights.

states.name: carrier_pad
states.note: Tern's ship on the pad beyond the gate.

states.name: roofs_from_trench
states.note: Looking back up the trench at the roofs and tanks the neighbours crossed.
